messages:
emma: Heads-up — planning TF apply for cross-region VPC route reroute + IAM provider/module pin tonight during the change window (23:00 PT). This ties to the v2.9.1 release.

david: which workspaces are we touching? staging + prod?

emma: staging + prod. workspaces: us-west-2-staging, us-west-2-prod. Plan includes route table assoc updates to point to new TGW attachment and pinning the aws provider to 4.61.0 to avoid drift.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] scheduled terraform plan for us-west-2-prod at 2026-03-19T23:05:00Z (run-id: r-00987-plan)

leo: can you paste the plan output here? any SG or NAT changes? want to be sure nothing opens up.

emma: no security group changes. Short plan summary: ~aws_route.main: change; +aws_route.new_association; +aws_route.backup_route. Also: update aws_iam_role.assume_role_policy (external_id add) and provider constraint added to root module.

maya: do we have a rollback runbook for the TGW reroute? last time it needed a manual route re-add.

emma: runbook link: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/tgw-reroute. Rollback steps in brief:
- revert module ref to previous tag and `git push`.
- `terraform apply -target=module.tgw` in workspace to re-create old attachment.
- re-add previous `aws_route` with `terraform apply -target=aws_route.old` if needed.
- notify NOC and flip traffic back via route propagation check.

sanjay: also pin the networking module. which tag should we use?

emma: pin `modules/networking` to `v1.12.3` in root `versions.tf` and update `registry_module` ref in the release branch. I'll push the tag + PR.

deploy-bot: terraform plan (us-west-2-prod) succeeded — plan shows 3 changes: +2, ~1, -0 (run-id: r-00987-plan)

david: I'll be on-call during the window. @oncall please ack.

sre-bot: @oncall ack — I'll monitor BGP sessions, TGW attachments, and healthchecks. Will raise pager if >3% error rate for 5m.

emma: starting apply at 23:05 PT unless objections. tagging release note draft: `v2.9.1 infra: TGW subnet reroute + provider/module pinning`.

leo: :thumbsup: go ahead

deploy-bot: terraform apply started (run-id: r-00987)

deploy-bot: apply progress: 3/3 complete — applying aws_route and aws_iam_role updates.

deploy-bot: terraform apply complete — 3 resources updated. No pending changes.

maya: verified routes in prod; traffic successfully flowing to new TGW. Healthchecks green.

sanjay: I saw a short spike of 502s (~90s) around 23:07 PT. Any rollback considered?

emma: we observed transient 502s traced to cold routing path warm-up. We kept the change after confirming failovers were healthy. Monitoring for +30m.

david: filing release note and linking runbook. Release note drafted in GH release: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/releases/tag/v2.9.1-infra

emma: pushed module tag and provider pin, updated CHANGELOG, and created a follow-up ticket to monitor metrics for 24h and validate no IAM permission regressions.

leo: thanks. closing this thread after post-deploy checks pass.

sre-bot: monitoring for 24h. No alerts as of last check.
